summary: Micropolis AI Robotics filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of a NYSE American delinquency notice for failure to timely file its annual 20-F for FY2025 due by May 15, 2026. The company has an initial cure period until November 15, 2026, with a possible additional six-month extension to May 15, 2027. The delay stems from ongoing audit matters. This is a routine listing compliance disclosure, not an actionable special situation; the filing does not trigger any transaction, strategic review, or capital event.
